<action type="say">
If it’s with the same bank but not showing up when you log in, that usually means the savings account isn’t properly linked to your online profile or there’s a status issue on the account (e.g., recently opened, dormant, or with different ownership details).

Here’s what to do to get the balance and fix the visibility issue:

1) Contact the bank (phone or in-branch)
Tell them something like:
- “My savings account isn’t showing in online banking, but my credit card and auto loan are. Can you check that this savings account is linked to my online profile and active for online access?”

2) Have this info ready
- Your full name and DOB
- Last 4 digits of your SSN (or equivalent ID they use)
- The savings account number (if you have it) or any paperwork/card tied to it
- When and where you opened the savings account

3) Ask them specifically to:
- Confirm the account is open and active
- Link the savings account to the same online profile you’re using now
- Provide the current balance while you’re on the call/at the branch
- Give an estimate of how long it will take before it appears online

If you’d like, tell me how you prefer to contact them (phone vs. branch), and I can draft a short script you can read or refer to so the call/visit is quick and clear.</action>

messages.output_raw: I’d rather call than go into a branch. Can you draft a brief script I can use on the phone to get the balance and have the savings account linked to my online profile?

steps.output_raw:
<think>
User wants a concise phone script. No tools needed. Provide short, direct wording plus optional follow-up questions. </think>
<plan>
1. Provide a brief, ready-to-read phone script including verification, balance request, and linking request.
</plan>
<action type="say">
Here’s a short script you can read or adapt on the call:

---

“Hi, I’m calling because my savings account isn’t showing up in my online banking, but my other accounts are. I’d like to (1) get the current balance on that savings account and (2) have it linked to my existing online profile.

My name is [your full name], and I can verify my information.”

[Let them verify your identity: date of birth, last 4 of SSN, address, etc.]

“I know I have a savings account with you, but I don’t see it when I log in online. Could you please:

1) Confirm that the savings account is open and active,  
2) Tell me the current balance, and  
3) Link it to the same online banking profile I’m using for my other accounts?”

[If they need help finding the account:]

“I opened the savings account around [month/year] at [branch/location, if you know it]. I may not have the account number handy—could you locate it under my profile and verify it with me?”

[Before you hang up, ask:]

“Once it’s linked, how long should it take before I can see it online and in the mobile app? And is there anything else I need to do on my side?”

---

If you tell me what information you already have (e.g., partial account number, when you opened it), I can customize this script further for you.</action>
